palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed yellow crest, dark face mask, red armor, gray torso and gloves, source eyes and black outline from approved Idle.
reference: Own DSTS chr676 Agunimon mesh and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded 31px Idle with fixed row-47 shadow. Actions use proportional 96px framing and row-63 shadow; never trim Idle or Physical Attack.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own forward run with clear opposite arm and leg travel; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Own crouch-to-strike motion with readable side-facing kick and guarded recovery. Physical Attack is never trimmed.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own broad two-arm release gesture; no projectile, flame or glow is invented.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own lowered rest loop; dark source face and native eye state retained without painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own ordinary armored recoil; extreme alternate damage clips remain unused.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own broad arm-led sweep and recovery; no synthetic held weapon is added.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of the native crouch-to-strike motion; one engine HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Own vertical jump and landing; no artificial vertical offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Own guarded power-gathering stance and recovery; no aura or flame effect is invented.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own ready motion with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; endpoint excluded.
